# Ali Mohsen Maruf

> Personal portfolio of Ali Mohsen Maruf, a student, researcher, and builder based in Savar, Bangladesh. His work spans digital products, design, teaching, and spatial research.

## About

Ali studies Geography and Environment at Jahangirnagar University. His interests include digital products, research, teaching, design, and geography. This portfolio collects selected projects, experience, and notes.

## Selected projects

- [AmarApply](https://scholarships.amarapply.com): Scholarship discovery and information platform.
- [Made in Campus](https://madeincampus.live): A project built for campus life.
- [DMus.app](https://dmus.app): A storefront tool for social sellers in Bangladesh, with orders sent to WhatsApp.
- [JU land cover assessment](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/alimohsenmaruf_gis-qgis-spatialanalysis-activity-7510648950807314432-EwSI): Preliminary QGIS assessment of land cover at Jahangirnagar University.

## Experience and study

- BSc student in Geography and Environment at Jahangirnagar University; admitted through the B Unit for 2024–25, merit position 229.
- HSC Humanities graduate from Notre Dame College (2024), listed at position 07 in the Dhaka Education Board HSC merit list.
- SSC graduate from Faridganj Secondary School (2022), listed at position 10 in the Dhaka Education Board SSC merit list.
- Online instructor for Geography at OnlyArts and Economics at CeeSaw.
- Provides SSC and HSC tutoring around Jahangirnagar University.
- Tools and interests include QGIS, map design, spatial research, education technology, data structuring, and web administration.
